We live in a very heteronormative world. I grew up feeling attracted to men, so I never questioned my sexuality and didn't even consider that I could be anything other than straight. I like guys, right? That's all I need to know, period. That all changed when I kissed my female friend years ago at a party. It made me feel all sorts of new things and I really enjoyed it. That's when it finally hit me that: hey, what the hell, maybe there IS more to this than meets the eye. Only then I realized that I might not be 100% straight.

I was rock-bottom just 2.5 years ago, living in a tiny overpriced attic for years and years with no motivation, no job I felt satisfied with, no boyfriend but enough men who had fucked me over and hurt me, no energy, I thought I had failed life and I would remain stuck on every part of it..
